# CG-REQ-028: Request format changed

The `format` of a request value changed.

**Why it matters:** Format validation is optional in JSON Schema (A7).

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.formatChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: medium · potentially breaking: low · undetermined: low |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Format of {where} changed ({from} → {to}).
>
> A narrower format may reject values that were accepted before, if the provider validates formats.
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers send values valid for the new format.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: int64 → int32

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, format: int64}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer, format: int32}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Format of POST /x: the request body (application/json) changed (int64 → int32).

### Fires: email added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: email}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Format of POST /x: the request body (application/json) changed (none → email).

### Fires: date → date-time

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: date}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: date-time}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, low. Format of POST /x: the request body (application/json) changed (date → date-time).

### Does not fire: custom format unchanged

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
        requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, format: sku}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Whether the provider validates `format` is unknown.
